scope: design reference model only; no production runtime or Stripe/D1 verification

bounds.decisionTable: 4 payments x 9 refund profiles x 5 disputes x 2 review x 2 provider x 2 subject link
bounds.scheduleCoverage: all permutations only for specified independent event sets; not unbounded state-space proof

tests.name: finite decision table preserves money, device linkage and all blockers
partial refund + failed balance refund never restores purchase access
pending to failed restores only after all refund outcomes and business case resolution
independent refund observations converge across all 24 arrival permutations
refund history requires correction evidence; internal over-reservation rejects atomically
unknown local reservation never discards a confirmed external partial refund
reservation admission compares both revisions and rejects concurrent excess
fresh late bank failure compensates refund fact, retains history and requires manual resolution
late bank return on old refund does not rewrite the new purchase entitlement
old fenced correction cannot overwrite a newer refund observation
failed refund with outstanding refund obligation cannot restore access
non-card succeeded to requires_action correction is preserved but remains outside initial rail
refund duplicate observation is idempotent; changed body conflicts
expired worker cannot overwrite newer Provider observation
same fence with stale order revision rejects after concurrent policy change
refund + dispute order permutations preserve both independent facts
same buyer/package/mode resumes current order across devices; mode and buyer isolate
unknown refund retains active slot and cannot trigger new payment
old order late events cannot release or revoke a paid repurchase
selling paused leaves ownership intact; package review revocation stops execution
unlinked buyer remains paid and does not make the seller ineligible
provider integration not ready blocks both new sale and existing execution
cache converges to greatest revision across all 6 deliveries; deny never regresses
cache TTL anchors to checkedAt, not arrival, and cannot authorize financial actions
repurchase revision advances through old negative; same-revision changed decision conflicts
fresh recheck at unchanged revision may renew lease but old response cannot extend it
closed case without explicit entitlement disposition never restores access
alternative compensation closes the case while keeping terminated access revoked
support decision requires scope, order and entitlement revisions, and evidence atomically
verified contract reinstatement can restore latest order after late bank return
old-case reinstatement cannot replace a newer order pointer
new refund reopens a previously resolved case and discards old restore disposition
